notes.title: Triblock - update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Update 1.0.2[/h2]

What has been updated/improved/added:

[olist]
[*] You can choose the levels one by one or dozens.
[*] Added a level restart in the pause menu.
[*] In infinite mode, if the controller is not connected, control prompts do not appear.
[*] In infinite mode, when expanding the field, you can immediately put a block there without waiting for a new one.
[*] Added graphic effects (removing blocks, winning/losing).
[*] The blocks fall faster when dropped.
[*] Added 2 new sets of interchangeable images for blocks (games, programming).
[/olist]
